description_en: Enables the Simple Log Service (SLS) log delivery feature for a resource group
description_zh: 开通资源组SLS日志投递功能
kebab_example: aliyun eas create-resource-log --cluster-id cn-shanghai --resource-id eas-r-asdasdasd0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateResourceLog

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the resource group. For example, the region ID of China (Shanghai) is cn-shanghai
parameters.help_zh: 资源组所在的地域ID。例如华东2（上海）为cn-shanghai
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group. For more information about how to query the resource group ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412133.html
parameters.help_zh: 资源组的ID。如何查询资源组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412133.html
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The Simple Log Service (SLS) Logstore. For more information about how to query Logstores, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426970.html
parameters.help_zh: SLS日志库，如何查询日志库，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426970.html
parameters.name: log_store

parameters.help_en: The name of the Simple Log Service (SLS) project for the resource group. The project must be created in Simple Log Service in advance. This operation does not support automatic creation of the project. You can call the ListProject operation to query existing projects, or call the CreateProject operation to create a project first
parameters.help_zh: 资源组对应的 SLS 日志项目名称。该项目必须已在日志服务中创建，本接口不会自动创建项目；可通过 ListProject 查询现有项目，或先通过 CreateProject 创建项目
parameters.name: project_name

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The request body. This parameter is required. If it is omitted, the server cannot parse the request content. Both the ProjectName and LogStore fields are required
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 请求 Body。此参数实际为必填项，省略时服务端无法解析请求内容；其中 ProjectName 和 LogStore 均为必填字段
v1_body_parameters.name: body
